mission: The empty chamber investigation. Monitoring logs identify the escapee: Darth Veraine, Brotherhood alchemist and strategist, flagged by Gavran as the highest-risk anchor. She escaped weeks ago. She is already moving.
why_now: The dual threat becomes legible here — a failing seal and someone who understands the technique. The race starts in this scene.
conflict: Veraine was not merely a prisoner. She was a strategist. The logs show she spent days in the fortress after she woke, read the archive, understood the system, and left with a plan. The evidence of her patience is the thing that frightens Sera and Torin worst.
turning_point: Desh maps Veraine's post-escape movement through the fortress — she accessed every relevant terminal before she left. Kael's reaction when her name resolves on the display is the scene's quietest and most important beat.
opening_hook: The monitoring logs for the empty chamber span centuries — a slow, patient record of something working its way out from inside.
closing_hook: Veraine escaped weeks ago. She has had time to recover, acquire resources, and start moving along the Corridor. The race has already begun — and they are behind.
emotional_trajectory: Investigative tension -> dawning horror at Veraine's capabilities -> urgency

stakes.personal: Ben is now responsible for stopping someone with a thousand years of Sith knowledge
stakes.interpersonal: Kael's reaction to Veraine's file — recognition, then studied blankness. He knew her, or knew of her.
stakes.external: A Sith alchemist with knowledge of the forbidden technique is already exploiting the seal's failure

setting: Fortress Level 3 — the empty chamber, then monitoring station on Level 1
sensory_details: Damage inside the empty chamber not frantic but systematic — deliberate erosion carried on for centuries; Gavran's monitoring flags lit red and unanswered; the residue Veraine left in the Force different in quality from the three survivors — still, analytical, patient in a way that makes Ben's shoulders tighten
canon_elements_needed: Sith alchemy in Legends EU tradition and capabilities
Brotherhood of Darkness era Sith training and specializations
Stasis chamber escape mechanics and Force erosion techniques
Darth title usage and Sith identity in the Brotherhood era
action_beats: Ben pulls up Veraine's chamber monitoring logs on the flickering display
Desh catalogues signs of Veraine's post-escape activity — accessed terminals, moved equipment, supplies taken
Kael picks up Veraine's abandoned data tablet, examines it, then sets it down with deliberate care
Ben overlays Veraine's activity timestamps on the fortress map, tracing her methodical movements through every level
promises_planted: Veraine's philosophy will be coherent and unsettling (PP16)
notes: H05 is hard — the race begins. Kael's reaction to Veraine's file is the load-bearing small beat of this scene: noticeable but unexplained, he recognises her without saying so. Ben notices and files it and does not yet have a place to put it. Do not resolve it here. Diagnostic-voice trap — Ben should not, in this scene, construct Veraine's philosophy from her activity pattern. He reads behaviour (she studied, she planned, she moved methodically) and feels the patience in the residue she left behind. Articulating her thesis is Ch16's work, not Ch5's.
